gaps.explanation: The report itself does not add up on p4 (Statement of Revenues, Expenditures and Changes in Fund Balances - Governmental Funds). The Total Governmental Funds column prints Culture and recreation 173,111, but the only fund with that function, Park Fund, prints 173,117 (Park total expenditures 324,176 = 173,117 + 151,059). The JSON statement line 'Culture and Recreation' 173,111 (p4) is therefore 6 below the column it totals. Fund-column totals 1,282,457 + 636,314 + 0 + 19,992 + 324,176 + 183,437 = 2,446,376 = the printed Total expenditures 2,446,376 (reported_totals). The Total-column lines sum to 2,446,370. Detail (per-fund columns p4 plus the p10 combining schedule) = 2,446,376, which equals the printed total. No detail fix; the difference is the printed Total-column line (173,111 vs 173,117).
